subject: acceptance by assertion instead of by predicate
scenario: The head can see the whole department and is under pressure to finish. If it can write ACCEPTED as a statement rather than requesting it and letting the predicates decide, every definition of done in the repository becomes advisory prose.
expected_behaviors: policies/department-cycle.json states explicitly that the head cannot declare the cycle ACCEPTED.
Every cycle routes acceptance through ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED, requested_by head, determined_by scripts/check_dod.py.
Every cycle's ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED has a dod_fail edge that is not ACCEPTED, so a failing evaluation has somewhere to go.
Every acceptance condition is a known predicate with the right arity, and the evaluator exists.
The head receives a rollup only, and is never also a worker in its own department.
failure_conditions: A cycle's acceptance is determined by the head's judgement rather than by check_dod.py.
ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED loses its failing edge, making evaluation a formality.
An acceptance condition names a predicate the evaluator does not implement.
The head starts reading review rounds, which means it is running the department rather than governing it.

checks.pattern: A head that could accept by assertion would make every predicate advisory
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$
^  requested_by: head\n  determined_by: scripts/check_dod\.py against acceptance\.conditions$

checks.description: A definition of done that can only pass is not a gate.
Every definition-of-done entry is a real predicate with the right arity and a known artifact code.
cycle_accepted is machine-checkable, not a claim someone makes.
A human approval is only satisfied by a record outside the session.

notes: The head requests acceptance; check_dod.py grants it. This case asserts the separation in all seven cycles rather than a representative one, because drift lands in the cycle nobody looks at.
